name: Classical Weimar
description: Classical Weimar is a group of eleven sites in and around the small Thuringian city of Weimar, Germany. Between 1772 and 1805 it was home to Goethe, Schiller, Herder and Wieland, and you can still visit their houses, as well as the elegant palaces and landscaped parks that grew up around the town during this remarkable literary golden age.
